# g-track

> g-track is a developer activity tracking app. It pulls a developer's activity from GitHub (commits, pull requests, issues, reviews), normalizes it into a unified event model, and visualizes it as a dashboard with an activity heatmap and charts.

Sign-in is via GitHub OAuth. The dashboard is private to each user; only the marketing pages are public.

## Features

- GitHub activity sync: commits, pull requests, issues, and code reviews
- Activity heatmap and per-day charts of a developer's work
- Normalized event model designed to support more sources over time
